CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD( Rep_Ownership_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 0 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 4, /* Sun:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+0 wknd day+5 days +2wknd days +5days + 2wknd days +4days */ 2, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 3 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 +1, /* Wed:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +3 day+2 wknd days +5days +2wknd days + 5days +2wknd days +1day*/ 3, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 2, /* Wed:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +2 day+2 wknd days +5days + 2wknd days +5days + 2wknd days +2days*/ 4, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 3, /* Thr:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +1 day +2wknd days +5days +2wknd +5days +2wknd +3days*/ 5, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 4, /* Fri:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+2 wknd days +5days +2wknd +5days +2wknd +4days*/ 6, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 5 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 4, /* Sat:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+1 wknd days +5days +2wknd +5days +2wknd +4days*/ Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 4 + 2 + 5 + 2 + 5 /* Default (Mon):Rep_Ownership_Date__c+4day +2wknd +5days + 2wknd +5days */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (14th)
